title: On the Linearization of Flat Multi-Input Systems via Prolongations
summary: We examine when differentially flat nonlinear control systems with more than two inputs can be rendered static feedback linearizable by a minimal number of prolongations of suitably chosen inputs after applying a static input transformation. We derive sufficient conditions that guarantee such prolongations yield a static feedback linearizable system.
